name: LukaCodes Content Expiry Shortcode
author: LukaCodes

sections.description:
Have you ever published a limited-time offer, an event announcement, or a seasonal promotion — and then forgotten to take it down?

LukaCodes Content Expiry Shortcode solves this in the simplest way possible. Wrap your content with the [lcexp] shortcode, set a deadline, and it disappears automatically when the time comes. No reminders, no manual editing, no stress.

Usage:

[lcexp "30-06-2026 23:59"]This offer ends June 30th![/lcexp]

Once the deadline passes, the content is automatically replaced with a clean expiry message. No broken layouts, no empty spaces.

Accepted date formats:

  • DD-MM-YYYY HH:MM — expires at exact time
  • DD-MM-YYYY — expires at midnight

Free features:

  • [lcexp] shortcode — works in any post, page, or widget
  • Date + time support — set it down to the minute
  • Clean expiry message shown after deadline
  • Works with any WordPress theme
  • Multilingual ready (English, Greek)

Premium features — available at lukacodes.com:

  • Gutenberg block with visual editor and live status indicator
  • Toolbar button — select any text and set expiry like Bold or Italic
  • Sidebar date picker with active/expired preview
sections.installation:
1. Upload the lukacodes-content-expiry-shortcode folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Use [lcexp "DD-MM-YYYY HH:MM"]Your content here[/lcexp] in any post or page.
sections.faq:
What happens to my content after the expiry date?

The content is automatically replaced with: “This content is no longer available.”

What timezone does the plugin use?

The plugin uses your WordPress site timezone. Go to Settings → General → Timezone to check or change it.

Does it work with the Classic Editor?

Yes — the shortcode works in both Classic Editor and Gutenberg.

Does it work with any theme?

Yes — the plugin is compatible with any WordPress theme.

What date format should I use?

Use DD-MM-YYYY HH:MM for an exact time, or DD-MM-YYYY to expire at midnight. Slash separators (DD/MM/YYYY) are also accepted.
